detail.title: Intex 4-in-1 USB Hub 3.0 with High-Speed Data Transfer
detail.overview: Upgrade your connectivity with the Intex 4-in-1 USB Hub 3.0, designed for high performance and seamless multitasking. With four USB 3.0 ports, this hub allows you to connect multiple devices simultaneously while ensuring ultra-fast data transmission up to 5Gbps. Its sleek, compact design makes it perfect for travel and everyday use. Built with a durable structure and integrated safety features, it offers reliable performance without the need for additional drivers—just plug and play.
features: Compatibility: Wide compatibility with laptops, desktops, and other USB-enabled devices
Build: Durable body with Built-in IC protection
Features: High-speed data transfer, stable performance
Usage: Ideal for connecting pen drives, keyboards, mouse, external HDDs, and more
